bosses: Gray Wing Guardian: ash feathered giant sentinel with stone mask, long spear, two ragged gray wings
Fallen Paladin: massive broad armored knight, cracked ivory breastplate, blackened kite shield, heavy mace, exposed grim face
Black Confessor: tall gaunt hooded priest with hanging censers and chained black scripture, smoky faceless hood
Blackwing Inquisitor: lean masked judge with swept black wings and hooked execution polearm, layered silver armor
Sanctuary Destroyer Azael: huge horned cathedral golem, broken columns on shoulders, stone fists and shattered halo embedded in chest
Fallen Angel Raziel: majestic pale humanoid angel with six charred wings, fractured halo, ornate black sword, ruined celestial armor
Blood Moon Hound: monstrous low quadruped hound, split antler crown, blood red mane and obsidian claws
Crimson Armored Soldier: stocky animated suit of crimson layered plate armor, round spiked shield, short serrated axe
Bloodmist Witch: floating pale witch with long red veil, thorn staff, ribbon-like blood fog and intricate dress
Eclipse Executioner: tall hooded armored executioner wielding huge crescent axe, eclipsed disc above shoulders
Calamity Lord Karmon: towering muscular demon with asymmetrical giant horn and molten red armored arm carrying brutal war hammer
Bloodmoon King Varkas: undead regal vampire monarch, spiked crown, black red mantle, ornate huge crimson greatsword
Star-Eating Beast: bizarre cosmic quadruped with crystalline jaw and a void filled with tiny dying stars inside its abdomen
Void Astrologer: floating robed many-handed astronomer, faceless silver mask, small broken astronomical rings orbiting shoulders
Black Star Knight: slender indigo plate knight, pointed star helmet and needle lance, armored cloak
Constellation Destroyer: giant four-armed titan of fractured dark crystal gripping broken stellar chains
Lightless Celestial God: alien humanoid divinity with smooth black orb head, silver skeletal armor and floating riblike arcs
Black Constellation Astreon: majestic cosmic deity with crown of dead stars, vast celestial winglike mantle and star spear
Rift Parasite: sinister six-legged chitin parasite with open radial maw, translucent violet sacs and jagged hooked limbs
Abyss Devouring Beast: hulking eyeless predator with overlapping obsidian jaws, low broad shoulders and long hooked tail
Void Gatekeeper: colossal hollow armored sentinel with rectangular gateway chest and two stone cleavers
Soul Glutton: floating spectral monster with chained skull mask, many ghostly grasping hands and empty rib cage
Dimension Eater Morga: serpentine arthropod monster coiled facing forward with split dragonlike head and blade forelimbs
Void Devourer King Nebiros: crowned massive abyssal behemoth with circular maw torso, horned head and four imposing arms
Godslayer Vanguard: angular black gold soldier with jagged spear and broken celestial shield, narrow hawk helm
Faceless Executioner: broad giant with perfectly smooth black mask, enormous chained sword, heavy black gold pauldrons
Black Hierophant: regal floating priest, tall black gold mitre, dark orb staff and layered feather robes
Archangel of Ruin: formidable armored angel with four skeletal black wings, broken gold halo and twin long blades
Godslayer General Arkaine: colossal battle-scarred warlord, lionlike gold helm, torn cape and oversized halberd
Fallen God King Belzerion: final majestic king, abyss-black celestial armor, crown of fractured halos, six vast charred wings, colossal dark jeweled sword
